title: Acteoside: a novel green inhibitor for the corrosion of copper in 1.0 M HNO3 solution: experimental and theoretical investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9335-9347
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01657F, Paper
Open Access

Mahmoud A. Al-Qudah, Tareq T. Bataineh, Faten M. Abu Orabi, Sultan T. Abu-Orabi, Ghassab M. Al-Mazaideh, Abbas I. Alakhras
Acteoside (ACT) isolated from A. orientalis L. was investigated as a corrosion inhibitor of copper in 1.0 M HNO3 acid solutions using conventional weight loss, electrochemical polarization, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) studies.
